notes: Paste with formatting: headings, bold, italic, lists, checklists and tables from ChatGPT, web pages and documents, in the board's own font (Ctrl+Shift+V pastes plain text) Align panel on the toolbar: align and distribute selected items, also with Alt+A/H/D/W/V/S and Alt+Shift+H/V The sample text of a new code block or sticky disappears when you start typing or paste
